landing.hero_body: Streamline your artist organisation and keep the full overview — setlists, song catalogue, PRO reporting, social reach, platform availability. Built by a musician, for musicians. No subscriptions. No bloat.
landing.feat_setlists_body: Generate by energy, duration, and feel. Drag-and-drop reorder. Save to gigs. Share as PDF.
landing.feat_songs_body: Full catalogue with play count, AI lyrics, audio and sheet music attachments, full change log.
landing.feat_pro_body: Import performing rights organisation data — CSV with dry-run preview and catalogue auto-matching.
landing.feat_gigs_body: Venues, contracts, set times, contacts, and finances — linked to your setlists.
landing.feat_venues_body: Searchable profiles with capacity, genre fit, booking contacts, and fee history.
landing.feat_tour_body: AI-optimised routing, booking outreach, revenue forecast, conflict detection.
landing.feat_hub_body: Song availability across platforms, social media reach, physical sales, and streaming integrations.
landing.feat_stage_body: Full-screen setlist display built for the stage. Song, key, capo, and notes — nothing else.
landing.bottom_intro_pre: smartist is open source. Run it yourself for free — full source on
landing.bottom_intro_post: — or let us handle hosting, updates, and integrations with a managed subscription.
landing.plan_self_body: Deploy to your own Vercel account. Full source, MIT licensed. One band, one database, yours to own.
landing.plan_managed_body: Your band is live in 24 hours. Hosting, backups, domain, integrations — all included. Cancel anytime.
landing.subscribe_blurb: Stay in the loop — early access, feature releases, and launch news.
landing.footer_text: open source · MIT · built by a working musician · 2026 ·
landing.cookie_text: This site stores no tracking cookies. The demo uses session storage for functionality only — cleared when you close the tab.
landing.subscribe_success: You're in — we'll be in touch.
